query: Which unit of randomization (student, classroom, or school) best balances statistical power, contamination risk, and operational feasibility for a Solomon four‑group trial in two public primary schools?

response.query: Which unit of randomization (student, classroom, or school) best balances statistical power, contamination risk, and operational feasibility for a Solomon four‑group trial in two public primary schools?
response.answer: For a Solomon four-group trial in two public primary schools, randomization at the classroom level balances statistical power, contamination risk, and operational feasibility best.

results.content: *   [Recommendations for Reporting Trials of Nonpharmacologic Treatments](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/10.7326/0003-4819-148-4-200802190-00008#sec-1). The CONSORT (Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials) Statement, published in 1996 and revised in 2001, is a set of guidelines designed to improve the reporting of randomized, controlled trials (RCTs) [(1, 2)](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/10.7326/0003-4819-148-4-200802190-00008#r1-8). To overcome these problems, care providers participating in a trial might perform interventions only in their preferred treatment group (expertise-based RCT) [(58)](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/10.7326/0003-4819-148-4-200802190-00008#r58-8). As outlined in the CONSORT Statement, the flow of individual participants through each stage of the trial should be reported: the number of persons evaluated for potential enrollment, randomly assigned to each group, who received treatment as allocated, who completed treatment as allocated, who completed follow-up as planned, and included in the main analyses in each group [(2)](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/10.7326/0003-4819-148-4-200802190-00008#r2-8). *   [CONSORT 2010 Statement: Updated Guidelines for Reporting Parallel Group Randomized Trials](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/abs/10.7326/0003-4819-152-11-201006010-00232). *   [Methods and Processes of the CONSORT Group: Example of an Extension for Trials Assessing Nonpharmacologic Treatments](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/abs/10.7326/0003-4819-148-4-200802190-00008-w1).

results.content: 8 academic program ACADEMIC REQUIREMENTS The course of study at Hampden-Sydney College offers to students opportunities for both breadth and depth in learning and encourages independent study. INTERNATIONAL STUDIES In addition to the College’s own academic study-abroad programs, Hampden-Sydney students are eligible to participate and earn academic credits in approved foreign-study programs sponsored by other colleges or educational organizations. Upon completion of the College’s core and major requirements with a B+ or higher average in his mathematics and science courses as well as overall, he applies for admission to the University of Virginia’s School of Engineering and Applied Science as a special non-degree undergraduate student. Upon completing the prescribed courses with a minimum 2.7 grade point average and a C or better in all applicable courses during the first three years 19 academic program at Hampden-Sydney College, dual-degree students complete the transfer admissions application to Old Dominion University.
